أستمجد (form X)
# أَسْتَمْجِدُ (ʔastamjidu) /ʔas.tam.d͡ʒi.du/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَمْجَدَ (istamjada)
# أُسْتَمْجَدُ (ʔustamjadu) /ʔus.tam.d͡ʒa.du/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَمْجَدَ (istamjada)
# أَسْتَمْجِدَ (ʔastamjida) /ʔas.tam.d͡ʒi.da/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَمْجَدَ (istamjada)
# أُسْتَمْ
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
